ranks.name: Lady Warden
ranks.desc: Tasked with guiding policy, the Lord or Lady Warden presides over the Warden's Council as first among equals.

ranks.name: Warden
ranks.desc: Wardens oversee the Argent Gryphon in all its affairs, bearing responsibility for its purpose.

ranks.name: Oathsworn
ranks.desc: Oathsworn have mastered the Order's lore and sworn themselves to preserve its traditions and uphold its ancient oaths.

ranks.name: Silverheart
ranks.desc: Silverhearts have shown exceptional prowess in battle and stand among the finest warriors of the Argent Gryphon.

ranks.name: Lorekeeper
ranks.desc: Lorekeepers possess a deep knowledge of the Order's history and traditions, entrusted with preserving its lore and passing it on.

ranks.name: Chevalier
ranks.desc: Chevaliers are seasoned warriors whose skill and experience have earned them the distinction of fighting beneath the Gryphon's banner.

ranks.name: Illuminated
ranks.desc: The Illuminated have begun to uncover the history, traditions and hidden knowledge upon which the Order stands.

ranks.name: Vanguard
ranks.desc: Vanguards have proven their prowess in battle and earned their place among those who take up arms for the Argent Gryphon.

ranks.name: Shieldbearer
ranks.desc: Shieldbearers are full members of the Order, having proven themselves worthy to bear the Griffin Shield and stand among their fellow Gryphons.

ranks.name: Companion
ranks.desc: Companions are welcomed friends of the Argent Gryphon who dwell among its members, whether or not they ultimately choose to join the Order.

ranks.name: Emissary
ranks.desc: The Emissary represents the another guild within the Argent Gryphon, ensuring both allies stand united against Zathroth.
